=== Strategy ===

Slowable.

CH chain: "got 6 clerics on the loop, doing second cast before slow and 6 sec afterwards, assuming a good MT".

This mob gates if you pull her too far from her spawn point.

Wizards: Sunstrike lands almost every time and frequently for near full damage. Solist resisted every time.
